title: SharePoint admin center: Copilot skills for step-by-step guidance and multi-criteria site search
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft supports the feature description, automatic enablement, licensing and both control paths and commands. Corrections should qualify the reporting licence statement, name the Graph request-body property, and remove the unsupported generalisation about how many administrators hold Copilot licences.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The cmdlet reference says a SharePoint Advanced Management licence is required to run Data access governance reports.
claims.quote: SharePoint Advanced Management (SAM) license is required to run these reports.
claims.fix: Retain the cmdlet-reference attribution, but qualify the blanket reporting requirement in the note, prose and checklist: 'The snapshot report shown here requires SharePoint Advanced Management. The Data access governance overview also documents limited activity reporting with Microsoft 365 E5, without snapshot reports or remedial actions.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/data-access-governance-reports, which is already in sources.

claims.quote: SharePoint Advanced Management is available as part of Microsoft 365 Copilot or as an add-on.

claims.claim: Group members can be added in Microsoft Entra admin center through Entra ID > Groups > All groups > group > Members > + Add.
claims.quote:
Browse to Entra ID > Groups > All groups.
3. Select the group you need to manage.
4. Select either Members or Owners.
5. Select + Add (members or owners).

claims.claim: POST /v1.0/groups/{group-id}/members/$ref adds a member to the exclusion security group.
claims.quote: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/groups/{group-id}/members/$ref
claims.fix: Keep the endpoint unchanged; the automatic pre-check is a false alarm. Append to controls[0].note and the rendered note: 'The request body sets @odata.id to the reference for the administrator being added.' The property is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/group-post-members.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Adding administrators to a custom security group named CopilotForM365AdminExclude automatically disables their Copilot experience.
claims.quote: set up a custom security group called CopilotForM365AdminExclude, and then add the administrators you don't want to have the Copilot experience. Once the group is configured, the Copilot experience is automatically disabled for those users.

claims.claim: The documented Entra group-management procedure uses the Groups Administrator or User Administrator role.
claims.quote: You'll need the Groups Administrator or User Administrator role to add members and owners.

claims.claim: Data access governance reports are accessed in SharePoint admin center through Reports > Data access governance.
claims.quote: In the left pane, expand Reports and then select Data access governance.

claims.claim: Start-SPODataAccessGovernanceInsight supports the printed PermissionedUsers, SharePoint and Snapshot options with Name and CountOfUsersMoreThan.
claims.quote: Start-SPODataAccessGovernanceInsight -ReportEntity PermissionedUsers -Workload SharePoint -ReportType Snapshot -Name "OversharingBaselineReport" -CountOfUsersMoreThan 0

claims.claim: The Data access governance command generates an oversharing report rather than restricting Copilot.
claims.quote: This cmdlet generates Data Access Governance (DAG) reports meant to provide insights into potential oversharing of sensitive data in SharePoint and/or OneDrive for Business.

claims.claim: The documented report-access procedure uses SharePoint administrator credentials.
claims.quote: Sign in to the SharePoint admin center with the SharePoint administrator credentials for your organization.

claims.where: Governance controls: disabling the experience; Open questions: admin-center switch
claims.claim: The feature's Learn page describes exclusion-group membership, not a tenant-wide SharePoint admin-center switch, as the way to disable it.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot" "SharePoint admin center" "disable" "switch". Opened https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/copilot-skills-sharepoint-admin-centers; its disabling FAQ documents only CopilotForM365AdminExclude.

claims.claim: The feature's Learn page states no separate meter.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot" "SharePoint admin center" "meter" cost license. Opened the Copilot skills feature page and Microsoft Copilot requirements; read the pay-as-you-go meters search excerpt. The feature FAQ states licence inclusion and no meter.

claims.claim: Only a subset of administrators in most tenants hold a Microsoft Copilot licence.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot" "administrators" "subset" license tenants; "SharePoint administrators" "Copilot license" "most". Read feature FAQ, Microsoft Copilot requirements and licence-options excerpts; none states how common administrator licensing is.
claims.fix: Remove 'which only a subset of administrators in most tenants will hold'. Keep: 'Medium. The feature requires a Microsoft Copilot licence for each administrator who uses it; no separate meter is stated on the feature page.'

claims.claim: The experience generates its answers using generative AI.
claims.quote: Copilot in the SharePoint admin center uses generative AI to make you more productive by simplifying administration of SharePoint and OneDrive.

claims.claim: This particular experience is administrator-facing rather than an end-user feature.
claims.quote: The feature is available to SharePoint administrators.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The governance checklist asks readers to check Microsoft Purview Audit, but that monitoring surface has no controls-table row.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'Check in Microsoft Purview Audit which records appear for Copilot in the SharePoint admin center'. Table: 'Which administrators can use Copilot in the SharePoint admin center'; 'Data access governance reports'.
claims.fix: Remove the checklist bullet beginning 'Check in Microsoft Purview Audit'. Retain the audit-event question in Open questions; do not add a control row as part of this correction.
